verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a training opt-out, a no-training data policy, or any training-related data-use control for Pipecat or Pipecat Cloud. Support for self-hosting and local inference through ollama or whisper is an architectural workaround that may keep data local. It is not a documented capability to prevent data from being used for model training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
